companyDescription: Quantum computing · annealing (Advantage2) + gate-model via Quantum Circuits acquisition (Jan 2026) · Q3 2026 revenue $4.5M (+21%), RPO $38.3M (+1,221%) · $503M cash · up to $100M CHIPS Act agreement
priceNote: Live $7.31 (+12.12%, Nov 23 close, Yahoo) after the Nov 23 rebound. About 77% below the $32.19 52-week high, ~60% below the 200-day (~$18.12) and ~12% above the 52-week low ($6.52).
summary: The quantum basket's best balance sheet at a crash price. D-Wave holds $503.4M of cash and securities against an adjusted EBITDA loss of ~$38M a quarter, which is about three years of runway. RPO jumped 1,221% to $38.3M, it signed up to $100M of CHIPS Act funding, and management expects to recognise a large part of the Florida Atlantic University system revenue in Q4. Q3 bookings fell 19% and gross margin dropped to 52.9%, so the quarter was not clean. The stock is ~77% off its high. Base +65% is a 6–12 month horizon recovering half the gap to the 200-day, which is above the turbo P75 (21.5%). แนะนำ 2% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 50%+.

catalysts.name: Florida Atlantic University system delivery (Q4 revenue)
catalysts.description: Management expects to deliver the FAU on-prem system and recognise a substantial part of that revenue in Q4 2026, a step-change versus the $4.5M Q3 revenue.

catalysts.name: Q4 2026 results
catalysts.description: The print that shows whether the FAU revenue landed and RPO is converting. No date announced (Q4 prints have historically come in March).

risks: Bookings fell 19% y/y to $1.9M in Q3 and gross margin dropped to 52.9% from 71.4% on a mix shift to professional services. Revenue is still tiny ($4.5M/quarter) against a ~$2.5B valuation.
Opex rose ~84% to $55.9M after the Quantum Circuits acquisition; cash fell to $503M from $836M a year earlier. At the current burn that is ~3 years of runway, but the burn is rising.
Narrative risk: quantum names sold off 60–80% in 2026; a single big-tech comment (e.g. Jan 2025 'quantum is 15–30 years away') has previously cut QBTS ~36% in a day.
Analyst targets are dated and dispersed (Mizuho $40 Feb 2026; consensus pages $23–37).
Macro WAIT (15/100) and a possible Dec 9 hike hit long-duration, pre-profit tech hardest.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.75–4.00%. CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~91% (Nov 23); futures dropped the 50bp tail after the November selloff.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct core CPI +0.3% m/m (hot). Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y; Oct PCE (Nov 25) consensus 3.2% is the last inflation print before the Fed.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Quantum is the most long-duration, pre-profit corner of tech: rate hikes and risk-off compress it first. D-Wave's cash pile means it can wait out the cycle without an equity raise at these prices.
macroRisk.summary: HIGH — /macro is WAIT (15/100, high conviction): S&P 7,237 is still below its 200-day (~7,340) after the Nov 23 +4.7% squeeze, VIX 27, breadth ~43% above 50DMA, HY OAS widening to ~3.52%. Turbo prior is unproven in this regime (0/107 windows had SPY down >2%).

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE · Moonshot 2% max — ~3 years of cash, RPO +1,221%, ~77% off the high. The turbo at-catalyst median is -6.6% (n=76), so Entry 2 ($6.50–7.00) is preferred; don't chase the +13% rebound day.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Quantum names trade on sector momentum more than individual prints; run-ups cluster around big-tech quantum announcements.

postWin.note: QBTS ran from ~$1 (Oct 2024) to ~$10+ (Jan 2025) on the late-2024 quantum re-rating. Single good prints typically add +20–40%.

postLose.note: QBTS fell ~36% on Jan 8, 2025 after big-tech comments that useful quantum was 15–30 years away.

spotSizing.reason: 2%. earnings_beat is a tier-2 leader (+13.9pp vs +7.7pp overall, n=15) — a mild tailwind, not a reason to upsize. The primary event is fuzzy and macro is WAIT.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the turbo medianMAE (-20%). Below the 52-week low with no bounce means the quantum bid is gone.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If Q4 shows no FAU revenue or RPO stalls, exit.

comparableCases.event: Late-2024 quantum sector re-rating (Willow, Advantage2 news)
comparableCases.note: Same company: a crushed quantum name re-rated ~9x in under three months once the sector narrative turned.
Peer confirms the move was sector-wide — QBTS upside depends on the basket, not just its own prints.
Narrative shocks hit hard and fast; size for it.
